hideDockDescMac: Run BiBoTracking from the menu bar only.
hideDockDescWindows: Run BiBoTracking from the system tray only.
unattendedRemoteAssistDesc: One-time authorization on this computer. Your administrator can then connect without a new prompt; a visible Stop button remains on screen and every session ends after 15 minutes.
managedNotice: ⌬ Managed by your organization — these are set by your admin and can't be changed here.
captureScreenshotsDesc: Periodically save screenshots of your screen(s)
countKeystrokesDesc: Count keypresses only — never which keys are pressed
captureBrowserUrlsDesc: Records the active address and duration. The extension is preferred; Windows can read only the address bar when it is absent.
modePrivacyDesc: Only the active window is captured — never the whole screen. No screenshot is taken while apps on the skip list are in front (prefilled with well-known chat, password and banking apps).
modeNormalDesc: Every screen is captured in full.
skipAppsDesc: No screenshot while these apps are in front. Use names as shown in Time by app, e.g. Zalo.
idleThresholdDesc: No input for this long pauses time counting
storeDomainOnlyDesc: Keep only the domain, never the full URL.
stillCaptureRetired: ⌬ Screen monitoring is video now — periodic screenshots are no longer captured, so these settings no longer apply. Screenshots taken before the change are kept until their retention period ends.
